title: Atlas · knee 5wk — the strictest payer says no

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Marcus, good to see you. How is the knee holding up since your last visit?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Still swelling after any real activity. Going down stairs is the worst part.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: You have kept up the physical therapy we started?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, five weeks of physical therapy now, twice a week with Dr. Imani.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Good. Can Dr. Imani's office send over the session notes for your chart?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Sure, they said they can share the notes whenever you need them.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Before we go further, any fevers, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No, none of that. Just the knee.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: For insurance, you are on Atlas through your employer, correct?

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Given the mechanical symptoms, I think it's time we get an MRI of that knee to look at the meniscus.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Whatever gets me an answer. Let's do it.
